# Sebastian Website Creation

> Websites for local trades and small businesses in Tampa Bay, Florida. Owner-operated: clients text their updates and everything technical is handled for them.

## What we do
- Custom websites for local businesses, built in about a week, mobile friendly, with a quote form on every page
- Google Business Profile management: posts, photos, and profile upkeep month after month
- Review management: every new Google review gets a reply
- Website care plans: hosting, security, backups, and changes handled, month to month with no contract

## Who we build for
Tree services, roofing, plumbing, lawn and landscaping, fencing, HVAC, pressure washing, and other local trades and small businesses.

## Service area
Tampa Bay, Florida: Tampa, Lutz, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Brandon, Riverview, Zephyrhills, Plant City, Gibsonton, Odessa, and Valrico.

## How it works
1. A free homepage mockup is built first, so the business sees the result before paying anything
2. The full site is built in about a week
3. Ongoing care keeps the site, Google profile, and reviews working month after month
